newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Petroz farms into Carnarvon Basin area.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Petroz farms into Carnarvon Basin area.

text.p: Petroz NL said on Wednesday it reached agreement with Mobil Corp's Ampolex Ltd unit to acquire a 20 percent interest in two offshore Carnarvon Basin exploration tenements.
The tenements, EP399 and EP400, lie in the Eastern Carnarvon Basin along a trend line from the Wandoo and Stag oil fields offshore Western Australia.
Petroz said its interest would be earned by funding part of Ampolex's costs of drilling the Border No 1 exploration well.
The cost to Petroz was confidential, a Petroz official said.
Typically, a farmin partner agrees to pay the bulk of the cost.
The well is expected to be drilled next month, Petroz said.
The objective of the well was to evaluate the Barrow Group reservoirs with a projected total depth of 735 metres, it said.

After completion of the farmin agreement, the participating interests in EP399 and EP400 would be Ampolex 45 percent, Clyde Exploration Plc and Petroz 20 percent each and Tap Oil NL unit, Tap Oil (Harriet) Pty Ltd, 15 percent, Petroz said.
